runtime.game: Installed CSGO legacy 1.38.8.1 / build 8802; offline -insecure local de_dust2
runtime.scope: Self-authored fixtures; visual loading, deformation, motion, entity movement and map reload. No exact per-frame or full stock physics parity claim.

cloth.result: All ten loaded and played idle. Projection and mixed-fit sheets visibly deform; locked control remains flat. Generated-bone projection, advanced sheet with visible collider shell and both rope variants load and run. Moving the cloth entities by 12 units in Z preserves visible finite simulation.
limits: The advanced collider shell below the sheet establishes loading only, not a controlled collision-effect comparison.
No per-node parameter measurement, penetration bound, equilibrium-shape or quantitative prerotation A/B claim.

rig.result: Rotation pointer changes direction between the nominal samples. Two-bone IK changes pose following the target marker.
rig.limit: SetAnimation plus delayed SetPlaybackRate 0 gives nominal timing only; no cycle readback or precise in-game bone angles.

reload.result: All twelve recreated and rendered after changelevel.

log_review.diagnostic_script_iterations: Initial Squirrel .01 literal and unquoted semicolon command failed; staging scripts were corrected and succeeded before observation and reload.
log_review.unrelated_engine_noise: Stock localization, radar resource, bot profile and material warnings remain in the local engine log.

implementation_notes: For a nonuniform local-position array whose maximum is 1, the descriptor uses nextafter(1,0) so the engine consumes the exact array values. Tests reproduce the reference runtime formula.
Aim target direction uses the actual slave translation in the same authored basis; mixed-coordinate old expected directions were corrected.
Two-sided projection finds the nearest eligible opposite face, preserves both side totals and reduces to the VVD three-weight limit.
Node sphere/plane stickiness is not exposed because the reference runtime does not consume it; effective rigid/stretch stickiness remains.
limits: FE output remains CSGO-only and respects engine bone/weight limits.
Rig is compiled animation; later QC edits, runtime IK and blending do not re-solve the authored graph.
Advanced collision runtime observation establishes loading/running only; no all-node penetration, equilibrium or per-frame stock parity measurement.
Source 2 mesh/world formats, engine changes, a full SFM editor, inactive reference TODO branches and an inactive reverse rig solver are excluded.
Native SubD still depends on a renderer supporting it; the installed legacy renderer has the previously documented null-stub crash. Default baked SubD remains available.
No new local Linux validation; published CI builds have separate logs and binary hashes.
